About the studio

Fernhill Pottery began in 2014 when Ana Marsh turned her grandfather's hay barn into a studio with three wheels and a second-hand kiln.

Today we teach small groups of six, so everyone gets time at the wheel and help when a pot collapses. Read how we choose our clay.
